detail.longDescription: I have a clipping issue with the legend of a chart, I found a possible solution but it just throws an error. The error in console is: Uncaught TypeError: Cannot set properties of undefined (setting 'mask') The code is: function createPie(chartDiv, legend, labels) { am4core.useTheme(am4themes_material); am4core.useTheme(am4themes_animated); var chart = am4core.create(chartDiv, am4charts.PieChart); var chartID = $('#' + chartDiv).data("chart"); let title = $('#' + chartDiv).data("title"); if (legend) { chart.legend = new am4charts.Legend() chart.legend.position = "absolute"; chart.legend.align = "left"; chart.legend.valign = "top"; chart.legend.x = am4core.percent(60); chart.legend.y = am4core.percent(1); chart.legend.hide(); } chart.dataSource.url = baseGraphsURL + chartID; chart.dataSource.parser = new am4core.JSONParser(); chart.dataSource.events.on("done", function (ev) { if (ev.target.data.length < 3) { var label = chart.createChild(am4core.Label); label.text = "No Data Available!"; label.fontSize = 20; label.align = "center"; label.dy = -150; } chart.data = JSON.parse(ev.target.data); }); if (title != '') { var header = chart.titles.create(); header.text = title; header.fontSize = 15; header.fontWeight = "bold"; header.marginBottom = 0; header.marginTop = 10; } var pieSeries = chart.series.push(new am4charts.PieSeries()); pieSeries.dataFields.value = "v"; pieSeries.dataFields.category = "c"; pieSeries.slices.template.stroke = am4core.color("#fff"); pieSeries.slices.template.strokeOpacity = 1; if (labels) { pieSeries.labels.template.disabled = false; chart.plotContainer.mask = null; } else { pieSeries.labels.template.disabled = true; } pieSeries.legendSettings.labelText = '{c}'; pieSeries.legendSettings.valueText = '{v}'; pieSeries.hiddenState.properties.opacity = 1; pieSeries.hiddenState.properties.endAngle = -90; pieSeries.hiddenState.properties.startAngle = -90; chart.hiddenState.properties.radius = am4core.percent(0); chart.chartContainer.events.on("over", function (ev) { if (legend) chart.legend.show(); }); chart.chartContainer.events.on("out", function (ev) { if (legend) chart.legend.hide(); }); chart.events.on("ready", function () { if (chart.svgContainer && legend) { chart.svgContainer.measure(); chart.mask = undefined; chart.mainContainer.mask = undefined; } }); } It is erroring on the chart.mainContainer line and the chart is a pie chart. I have tried doing it at different places and at different times using the event. But it always errors
